Hi Sam — great to meet you earlier. I’ve attached our vendor onboarding checklist (redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist_v1.xlsx) to this thread; below is a concise "what we need from you" and "what you can expect from us" so your finance and legal teams can act quickly.

What we need from you:
- Completed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8 (if non-US)
- Certificate of Insurance (general liability)
- Remit / billing contact and email (accounts-payable@onboardco.com)
- Bank details for ACH or wire (we provide secure form link below)
- Signed SOW or statement of services if applicable
- Primary contract contact for redlines / legal questions

What you can expect from Redwood:
- Vendor portal invite and secure upload link within 24 business hours
- PO creation after receipt of W-9 + banking info + approved SOW
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 (can discuss Net 45 / Net 60 for enterprise deals)
- DocuSign for contract signature; finance will receive final invoice format (PO number, line items, total)

Action items / next steps:
1) Please upload W-9 and COI to the portal link we’ll send.
2) Complete the secure bank detail form (link below) — we do not accept bank info via unsecured email.
3) Let us know if you need any deviations on payment terms or PO line item structure.

Portal / secure links: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-portal/invite/ONB-9342
Secure bank form: https://secure.redwood.example.com/vendor-bank-form?token=xyz123

I’ve cc’d Marcus (billing ops) to confirm the PO flow and Laura (procurement) for compliance items. If you prefer a short call to walk through the checklist, I can set 20 minutes tomorrow.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Hi Priya / Marcus / Laura — thanks, this is helpful. I attached our W-9 and COI to this reply (W-9_OnboardCo.pdf, Certificate_of_Insurance_OnboardCo.pdf).

- Are invoices required to reference a specific cost center / project code?
- Net 30 works; would that be calendar days from invoice date?

We prefer ACH. I’ll follow Priya’s upload instructions now. If you need a copy of our standard services agreement to speed contract review, I can share it — would you like that?

Thanks,
Sam

Hi Sam — welcome. A few clarifications from billing ops:  
- Invoices: please include PO number, invoice date, invoice number, line item description, and total. If a project code is required, include it in the "reference" field; we can also add a cost center on the PO.
- Payment terms: Net 30 calendar days from invoice date (unless otherwise agreed in the SOW).
- Tax/docs: For EU activities, we only need the local tax registration if Redwood issues EU invoices; for services delivered entirely from the US, W-9 is sufficient. If you’d like us to engage our tax team, mention country of operation and we’ll advise.

Portal invite: I’ve generated the vendor portal invite for your accounts-payable user. Link: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-portal/invite/ONB-9342 (expires in 7 days). Once uploaded, reply to this thread and we’ll queue the PO.

Secure bank details: please use the secure form — do not email bank routing numbers. Link: https://secure.redwood.example.com/vendor-bank-form?token=xyz123

Contract: yes, please share your standard services agreement if you have one; we’ll route to legal for a quick review. For routine onboarding we use our standard vendor terms; any redlines will come from legal.

I’m copying Laura for compliance review on the COI limits and any additional proof of vendor controls we might need.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
